nodes.summary: The absorption time of a `[0, 1]`-valued path: the first time it is at `0` or `1` (the infimum of the empty set is `0` in `ℝ≥0`; the path is absorbed almost surely, see `ae_exists_absorbed`).
nodes.title: Absorption time of a frequency path

nodes.summary: A solution of the Wright–Fisher martingale problem is almost surely absorbed: from some time on it is constantly `0` or constantly `1`.
nodes.title: Absorption in finite time

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is a `C²` function of the initial frequency on all of `ℝ`.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability is twice continuously differentiable

nodes.summary: For a solution of the neutral Wright–Fisher martingale problem started at frequency `x`, the expected time to loss or fixation, in units of `2N` generations, is `-2 (x log x + (1 - x) log (1 - x))`.
nodes.title: Kimura–Ohta mean absorption time, process form

nodes.summary: `X` solves the martingale problem for the Wright–Fisher diffusion with scaled genic selection coefficient `σ = 2Ns` (time in units of `2N` generations) with respect to the filtration `ℱ` and the measure `μ`: `X` takes values in `[0, 1]`, has continuous paths, is adapted to `ℱ`, and for every `C²` function `f` the process `f (X t) - f (X 0) - ∫₀ᵗ generator σ f (X s) ds` is an `ℱ`-martingale.
nodes.title: Martingale problem for the Wright–Fisher diffusion

nodes.summary: The slope constant of Kimura's formula is positive.
nodes.title: Positivity of Kimura's slope constant

nodes.summary: For a solution of the Wright–Fisher martingale problem with scaled selection coefficient `σ = 2Ns` started at frequency `x`, the probability that the allele is eventually fixed is `(1 - e^{-2σx}) / (1 - e^{-2σ})` (`x` when `σ = 0`).
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability, process form

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is strictly increasing in the initial frequency.
nodes.title: Strict monotonicity of Kimura's fixation probability
